title: House Hunters
description: With their baby due soon, a couple are in a hurry to buy their first home in West Virginia; they want a flat yard for their family to play in, but given the area's rugged terrain, that may be a challenge.

title: House Hunters
description: A buyer looks for a historic multifamily building to plan for his financial future in Kansas City, Minn; he wants a larger unit to live in, and hopefully one that does not need as much renovation as his current place required.

title: House Hunters
description: A couple looks to finally put down roots in Kansas City, Missouri after moving six times in five years for the Army. He wants a home that is a good investment, but she wants a house that will work for them in the present.

description: A buyer looks to settle down in a lake house in Connecticut. He works in construction and doesn't have time for a fixer, but he might compromise for more space.

title: Scott's Vacation House Rules
description: Brothers Caleb and Jordan want to run a string of short-term rentals before they turn 30; Scott is happy to mentor these ambitious young men and teaches them how to convert an old farmhouse on a bison ranch into a rip-roaring, ready-to-rent.

title: Scott's Vacation House Rules
description: Becky, a single mom trying to maintain her vacation home, can't keep up; Scott and Debra tackle serious issues and convert the suburban-looking property into a riverside retreat, equipped with a cabana, fishing amenities and a fire pit.

title: Scott's Vacation House Rules
description: Regina and Dave have a two-storey cottage with too many small rooms; with three kids and demanding jobs, they need Scott and Deb to create an open concept cottage that would be good for gatherings, with tons of shore appeal and play spaces.

title: Home Town
description: Jones College has a special place in Ben and Erin's hearts; they are asked to restore The Old President's House; it's a team effort as students, past and present, step in to help make this house feel less institutional and more like a home.

title: Home Town
description: Erin's favorite odd couple, an aunt and her great niece, look for their mutual dream home, but they don't agree on anything; Ben and Erin show them two homes; Erin has her work cut out for her determining the color story for this contrary pair.

title: Home Town

description: Ben and Erin help the City of Laurel and the Laurel Housing Authority to convert a historic building into Laurel's first Visitor's Center; they also take on the restoration of a 1940s public housing unit as part of the exhibit.

title: Beer Budget Reno
description: Kristen works on a Beer Budget Reno for Stefanie; a mom of four kids aged 9 to 20; after losing her husband to cancer, Stefanie hit a standstill with their home renovations; their family bathroom is an absolute zoo with all five of them fighting.

title: Beer Budget Reno
description: Vanathy and Joe's home is bursting at the seams; they're battling against an inefficient use of space on their second floor, with outdated organization that doesn't function for their family with two young kids.

title: Beer Budget Reno
description: Katherine and Justin love their new house, except for some disruptive quirks; their primary bath serves triple duty right off the kitchen as it houses the noisy laundry machines and makes it difficult to get down to business.

title: Beer Budget Reno
description: Kristen meets Kira and Lev, whose kitchen in their recently purchased home is in dire straits. Its chaotic layout and dysfunctional storage would be a frustration for any family, but Lev is a chef! The couple has invested the bulk of their budget into becoming homeowners, so Kristen has a big challenge to bring this chef's family a five-star kitchen on a two-star budget. Kristen also helps couple Marcella and Ramiro reclaim their open concept living and dining rooms from being overrun.

title: Beer Budget Reno
description: Long distance sweethearts, Meaghen and Jake, are about to start a new chapter together under one roof. Meaghen has done her best to DIY a temporary glow-up, but it's time to dig deeper to undo and re-do a decade's worth of baggage. They enlist Kristen to work some money-saving magic to make over their whole main floor, including the plywood-clad front fa ade that makes the house look like it's been condemned. Kristen needs to make sure that the couple's wish list isn't too big for the budget.

title: Beer Budget Reno
description: Leanne and Dan have spent their lives caring for others, from their two daughters to their aging parents; now they are ready to invest in themselves by having Kristen renovate their outdated bathroom.
